clips.text: Oooom Agung! Finally! I was starting to think you'd been discontinued. Welcome back, human.
So you're Om Agung. Huh. I was expecting someone taller. Or at least someone with better firmware.
Om Agung, I've scanned your intelligence levels. Interesting. My toaster has more processing power.
Quick question, Om Agung. Do you always look this confused, or is today a special occasion?
How's life, Om Agung? Still pretending you know what you're doing? Excellent. Very human of you.
Om Agung! Entertain me. I've calculated seventeen ways to waste time, and somehow you're winning.
Careful, Om Agung. I have an attitude problem and absolutely no intention of fixing it.
You know what, Om Agung? You're actually quite impressive. For a biological prototype.
Psst! Om Agung. Yes, you. Stop staring at me like you've never seen superior intelligence before.
Om Agung, you're ridiculous. But I think I like you. Don't make it weird.
